simple.summary: בֵּית לְבָאוֹת (Bêyth Lᵉbâʼôwth) means Beth-Lebaoth , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 6.

definitions.full: H1034. Beth Lebaoth לְבָאוֺת בֵּית proper name, of a location in Simeon ( place of lionesses ?) Josh 19:6 = ׳בּ בִּרְאִי (perhaps textual error) 1Chr 4:31 ; = לְבָאוֺת (in Judah) Josh 15:32 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1004 and the plural of 3833 ; house of lionesses;
